issues.desc: The revised checklist closes both architectural blockers. During PLAN, make the self-hosting path transition non-vacuous in verificationIntent: bind a concrete RED receipt through red_evidence_create, exercise story_get/checklist_get for B-022e across the canonical storyDir/config switch, and evaluate the same acceptance target GREEN at a descendant commit. This is advisory because CHK-002 now owns the identity and history invariants and lifecycle completion itself will fail if the story becomes undiscoverable.
